notes.title: Patch 0.5.0 : New enemies & 3D rooms
notes.notes:
Spellbound Shuffle v0.5.0 is now live on steam! 🌟

[*] New enemies :

All the enemies for "Act 1 : the Forest" have been implemented. Please greet :
- The Blossoms : specialized in ranged attacks and populating your deck with pollen cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/e113f9e1be7e1f820034f1abb1c6c6a78a46b504.png[/img]
- The dragonflies : specialized in mobility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/e22be799972b5799fe72fa766648bb32054bb4d3.png[/img]
- The Dummies : specialized in melee combat, 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/c22e7f8b99c5e1cbe9058b2edc05f6be19151d2a.png[/img]

we can't wait to see all the strategies you will utilize to best defeat these enemies,

[*]New shop :

Shop room has been rework to be in 3D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/aa890e6fd8a4b09f91526d78251b299fedcfd425.png[/img]


[*]New chest :

Chest room has been reworked to be in 3D :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/bc878ab4e30ace10b9f1bf68bec5240fb7a55c6a.gif[/img]

[h1]Next Fest preparation :[/h1]

At the time of this patch, we are preparing for Steam Next Fest on June 10th. From now on, the demo will be a trimmed down version of the final game. This demo version that will be playable for the whole fest contains only the first act.
Future content will be tested on the community discord.

We need your feedback! Share your thoughts and comments. This is crucial to helping us improve the game and make Spellbound Shuffle the experience you deserve.

Thank you for being part of this adventure,

Toma Games

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 notes : New environments, card rarity, visual polish
notes.notes:
Spellbound Shuffle v0.3.1 is now live on steam! 🌟

[list]
[*] New Environments:
Your adventure becomes even more captivating with the addition of three distinct acts - the mysterious forest, the desert you already know, and the terrifying hell. Each environment will be unique in the future, offering diverse mechanics, enemies and strategies. For now... those have not been implemented yet and will all contain the same 3 enemies you're already familiar with

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/478be6b84f7d7c0d777344fb34c522dd54dd7cc4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/eb01c71ce19bf787b99ff07c22ffbbeb0190f5c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/a2c189853476892097d5f108f60c1579c8038716.png[/img]

[*]Card rarity: 
Cards are now divided into common, rare and legendary. Visuals and drop rate are affected by the rarity. This applies in card rewards and shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/6f41e8147ff5263950ae1186afb061030d564274.png[/img]

[*]Improvements and Balancing:
Significant adjustments to the archer and his cards have been achieved, enhancing the overall balance of the game. Trap decks are now a more viable path for the Archer and some OP cards have been nerfed.

[*]Bug Fixes and Visual Enhancements:
This update fixes numerous bugs and enhances the overall visual aspect of the game, providing a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
[/list]



What's Next:
Get ready for the next major update, which will transform all game screens into 3D, from the character selection screen to the treasure and shop rooms. Detailed statistics will also be integrated into the end-of-run screen, allowing you to better track your performance.

The update will be available just in time for the Next Fest in June. A substantial content update that will introduce new cards for the archer and new characters is also on its way. Stay tuned!

We need your feedback! Share your thoughts and comments. This is crucial to helping us improve the game and make Spellbound Shuffle the experience you deserve.

Thank you for being part of this adventure,

Toma Games

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2 notes : NEW NAME, augment rewards, polish & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Following Steam Deckbuilder Fest, here are all the changes and improvements implemented :

[list]
[*]Game name : A feedback that was widely spread in the community was that the game's art direction didn't match the expectation set by the name aaaaaand... that's true. At first I wanted the game to be wild west themed, but as the development progressed, the art direction has evolved into something else. From now on, High Noon Shuffle is becoming Spellbound Shuffle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/0d142fd390977adef90e62b1811974b59376e4e4.png[/img]

[*] Move rework : clicking ➡ dragging
Instead of clicking on the character and then clicking on the ground again to move, it's now used by clicking on the character and dragging to where you want to move.

[*] Traps visual rework :

Traps have new visuals & animations. The goal here is to improve the understanding of what's on the ground by displaying an icon depending on what the trap does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/658b6bc323c76ebaeb6ed60388fac9272ba7f998.png[/img]

[*] Polishes :
- Obstacles were not always understood "can I shoot over this ?", "Can I walk on it ?". To mitigate this feeling, obstacles are now higher and have an icon showing that they block line of sight.
- New boost VFX for 
- New VFX when a negative status effect is applied to a unit
-Archer animations : The Archer character is now shooting arrows out of his bow instead of shooting them from the sky. 
- When hovering a card, the resource it uses is highlighted.
- Elite combat reward : gold, card, card ➡ gold, card, augment

[*] bug fixes : 
-Card tooltip was not working in shop.
- Elite's second card reward didn't give anything.

[*] Balancing :
- Archer Slow Trap : the immobilized status effect is too powerful to be in a starting deck. The slow trap card is replaced by the vulnerable trap in the starting deck but stays in the overall card pool.
- Bleed : Bleeding felt unfair for some players, especially because there was no way to remove it until the end of the combat. Bleed now decreases by 1 each turn.
[/list]

That's it for today. See you soon !

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 notes : Sounds, Card removal & better AI
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Musics & Sounds :

That's it for today. See you soon !

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 notes : New cards & visual improvements
notes.notes:
Hey there,

New Features and Enhancements:

[list]
[*]New Card Visuals: We've revamped the visuals of all cards! Each card now sports a fresh look along with a brand-new footer that provides crucial information such as line of sight, range, effect area, and launch area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/152b08e04a7e074d2649bdce92ce9c70984c25fb.png[/img]

[*]Reworked Arenas: Prepare for a whole new battlefield experience! We've reimagined the layouts of all arenas, making them more dynamic and engaging. Say goodbye to screen borders as arenas are now slightly more zoomed in, offering intensified action and strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/d21258b3a7850df6be32d74105324d0c431b73aa.png[/img]

[*]Movement System Overhaul: Say farewell to the old ways! We've revamped the movement system, saying goodbye to card-based movement. Now, navigate your character seamlessly by simply clicking on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/c37ce4c62ad0e960fd06340ee80070b6b4decd63.gif[/img]

[*]UI Overhaul: We've listened to your feedback and given the entire user interface a fresh coat of paint! From buttons to icons, and even the map itself, everything has been polished and refined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/13ea20657f33e93127abc8fb07aa82e5a14da61d.png[/img]

[*]Bug Fixes:We've squashed numerous bugs and glitches to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience for all players.
[/list]

We also want to extend a heartfelt thank you to our dedicated players for their continued support and valuable feedback. Your passion drives us to continuously improve the game. Don't forget to join our Discord server here to connect with fellow players, share your thoughts, and stay updated with the latest news and events! 
[url=https://discord.gg/JTMvjGP5e6] Discord server [/url] 

Special Announcement:

Exciting news! Our game will be part of the Steam Deckbuilders Festival on March 25th. Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into the festival for exclusive events, challenges, and surprises. Stay tuned for more details as we approach the event date!

We hope you enjoy these updates and look forward to seeing you in the arenas !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624056/7f9b46f2f062b0bceaf8b74bc7ee09dc661660ed.gif[/img]
